one_liner: Amazon's official REST API for sellers and vendors to programmatically manage orders, inventory, payments, and catalog data.
blocker: Multi-step onboarding: developer account registration, SP-API role qualification requests, application registration, and OAuth/self-authorization setup before production credentials work.

evidence.claim: SP-API is a REST-based API covering orders, shipments, payments, and more (broad surface).
evidence.quote: The Selling Partner API (SP-API) is a REST-based API that helps Amazon selling partners programmatically access their data on orders, shipments, payments

evidence.claim: Authorization is OAuth 2.0 via Login with Amazon; private apps can self-authorize.
evidence.quote: The authorization model for the Selling Partner API is based on [Login with Amazon](https://developer.amazon.com/docs/login-with-amazon/documentation-overview.html), an Amazon implementation of OAuth 2.0.

evidence.claim: Developers can self-serve credentials by registering a developer account and application, but must also request and qualify for SP-API roles to access operations.
evidence.quote: you must request and qualify for a particular role, or you will not be able to access the operations and resources grouped under that role.

evidence.claim: Self-serve developer account creation is publicly offered.
evidence.quote: Automate orders, inventory & pricing with real-time data. Create your developer account today.

evidence.claim: Amazon ships an official MCP server for SP-API via its own GitHub org (amzn/selling-partner-api-samples).
evidence.quote: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) is an open protocol that allows AI assistants to access external tools and data sources.

notes: Amazon published an official Data Kiosk MCP server in its amzn/selling-partner-api-samples GitHub org (announced 2025/2026). Onboarding is lengthy (10-step flow including sandbox registration and production app listing); role approval can involve identity/business verification. The docs site itself offers an llms.txt index and OpenAPI endpoint definitions for AI agents. SP-API replaced the older MWS API, which is deprecated.
